title: 🥜🍫 Peanut & Chocolate Bonbons – Creamy, Keto-Friendly & Freezer-Ready! By: @chiara.fiorani
description:
📊 Estimated Macros (per bonbon, est. – makes 5):
Calories: ~60 | Fat: ~5 g | Protein: ~2.8 g | Net Carbs: ~1.5 g

Ingredients (Makes 5 bonbons):
⅔ cup full-fat Greek yogurt (150 g)
1 tbsp peanut butter (15 g)
1 tbsp cocoa powder (8 g)
Keto-friendly sweetener, to taste (I used sugar-free maple syrup, about 1–2 tsp / 5–10 ml)
Topping:
Sugar-free dark chocolate, melted (about 1 oz / 30 g)

Instructions:
In a bowl, combine the Greek yogurt, peanut butter, cocoa powder, and sweetener until smooth.
Spoon or shape the mixture into bonbons and place them on a parchment-lined tray.
Freeze for at least 4 hours, until fully firm.
Dip the frozen bonbons into the melted sugar-free dark chocolate.
Return to the freezer or fridge until the chocolate sets, then enjoy! 🫶🏼

title: How to Apply Sticky Tabs for Press-On Nails (Natural & Long-Lasting Fit 💅)
description:
Want your press-on nails to look salon-perfect and stay on longer? 💅 Learn the proper way to apply sticky tabs for a secure, natural-looking fit. Start with nail prep—push back cuticles, file the surface, and clean thoroughly. Choose the right size sticky tab and apply it carefully (not too close to the cuticle). Warm it with a hair dryer for 10 seconds, then press and activate the adhesive. Finally, place your press-on nail slightly above the cuticle, gently roll it down, and hold for 10 seconds for a strong, flawless finish.

description:
Whether you’re cozying up on the couch or hosting for the holidays, this easy pumpkin spice hot chocolate recipe should be your go-to treat. All you need are six ingredients & a crockpot to whip up this delish homemade drink:
 • (Serves 12)
 • 24 oz. milk chocolate chips
 • 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
 • 2 Tbsp. pumpkin pie spice or extract
 • 5 cinnamon sticks
 • 1 gallon of your milk of choice

As many marshmallows as your heart desires
